name: VolSplat Architecture and Training Pipeline
definition: A feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that extracts multi-scale 2D features, predicts depth via a plane-sweep cost volume, lifts features to a sparse 3D voxel grid, and predicts one Gaussian primitive per occupied voxel.
summary: VolSplat is a feed-forward network that directly regresses 3D Gaussian Splatting parameters from sparse multi-view images, bypassing per-scene optimization via sparse voxel grids.
